16:1: The command of Allah has come, so do not seek to hasten it. He is glorified and exalted above what they associate as partners.
16:2: He sends down the angels with the spirit of His command upon whom He wills of His servants, to warn that: 'There is no deity except Me, so fear Me.'
16:3: He created the heavens and the earth in truth; He is exalted above what they associate as partners.
16:4: He created man from a nutfah, and behold, he is an open adversary.
16:5: And the animals He also created; for you in them is warmth and many benefits, and of them you eat.
16:6: And for you in them is beauty when you bring them in to rest and when you take them out to pasture.
16:7: They carry your loads to a land you could not reach except with hardship to your souls. Indeed, your Rabb is Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
16:8: And [He creates] horses, mules, and donkeys for you to ride and for adornment, and He creates that which you do not know.
16:9: And to Allah belongs the direction of the way, and of it are crooked ones. And if He had willed, He would surely have guided you all.
16:10: He is the One Who sends down water from the sky; from it you drink, and from it are trees in which you pasture your animals.
16:11: With it He causes crops, olives, date palms, grapes, and of all kinds of fruits to grow for you. Indeed, in that is surely a sign for a people who reflect.
16:12: And He subjected for you the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. And the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed, in that are surely signs for a people who reason.
16:13: And He also created on the earth things of varying colors for you. Indeed, in that is surely a sign for a people who take heed.
16:14: He is the One Who also subjected the sea so that you may eat fresh meat from it and extract from it ornaments you wear, and you see the ships plowing through it, and that you may seek of His bounty, and so that you may be grateful.
16:15: And He placed firm mountains in the earth lest it shake with you, and rivers and roads so that you may find the right way.
16:16: And landmarks; and by the star they find guidance.
16:17: Is then He who creates like one who does not create? Will you not then take heed?
16:18: And if you should count the blessing of Allah, you could not enumerate it. Indeed, Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
16:19: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you disclose.
16:20: And those they pray to besides Allah do not create anything; rather, they are created.
16:21: They are dead, not alive, and they do not know when they will be resurrected.
16:22: Your deity is One Deity. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts deny and they are arrogant.
16:23: Undoubtedly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they disclose. Truly, He does not love the arrogant.
16:24: And when it is said to them, "What has your Rabb sent down?" they say, "Legends of the ancients."
16:25: So that they may carry their loads in full on the Day of Resurrection, and of the loads of those whom they led astray without knowledge. Beware, how evil is what they bear!
16:26: Indeed, those before them plotted, but Allah came upon their buildings from the foundations, so the roof collapsed upon them from above them, and the punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
16:27: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say: "Where are My partners for whose sake you used to dispute?" Those who were given knowledge will say: "Today disgrace and evil are upon the disbelievers."
16:28: While the angels were taking the souls of those who wronged themselves, they surrendered, saying: "We were not doing any evil." Nay! Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of what you used to do.
16:29: Come, enter the gates of Hell, abiding eternally therein. How evil is the dwelling place of the arrogant!
16:30: And when it is said to those of taqwa, "What has your Rabb sent down?" they say, "Good/goodness." For those who do good in this world there is a good reward, and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of those of taqwa!
16:31: Gardens of Adn they enter, rivers flow beneath them, therein whatever they wish is theirs; thus does Allah reward those of taqwa.
16:32: When the angels take them in a pure state, they say: "Peace be upon you; enter Paradise for what you used to do."
16:33: Do they wait for anything except that the angels should come to them or your Rabb's command should come? Thus did those before them do. Allah did not wrong them, but they were wronging themselves.
16:34: So the evils they did struck them, and that which they used to ridicule enveloped them.
16:35: And those who associated partners said: "If Allah had willed, neither we nor our forefathers would have worshipped anything besides Him, and we would not have made anything unlawful other than Him." Thus did those before them do. Then what is upon the messengers except clear notification?
16:36: And indeed, We sent to every nation a messenger [saying]: "Worship Allah and avoid taghut." So of them were some whom Allah guided, and of them were some upon whom error was justified. Travel through the earth and see how the end of the deniers was.
16:37: Even if you earnestly desire their guidance, indeed Allah does not guide those He causes to go astray, and they have no helpers.
16:38: And they swore by Allah with the utmost strength of their oaths that Allah will not resurrect one who dies. Nay, it is a true promise upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
16:39: To explain to them that wherein they differ, and so that those who disbelieve may know that they were liars.
16:40: Our word to a thing when We intend it is only that We say to it, "Be!", and it is.
16:41: And those who emigrated for the sake of Allah after having been wronged, We will surely settle them well in the world; and the reward of the Hereafter is surely greater.
16:42: They are the ones who are patient and put their trust in their Rabb.
16:43: And We did not send before you except men to whom We revealed; ask the people of the Zikr if you do not know.
16:44: With clear proofs and scriptures. And We sent down to you the Zikr so that you may clarify to the people what was sent down to them, and perhaps they will reflect.
16:45: Did those who plotted evil deeds feel secure that Allah would not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the punishment would not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
16:46: Or that He will seize them during their going about; and they cannot frustrate [Him]?
16:47: Or that He will seize them in a state of fear; indeed, your Rabb is surely Compassionate, Rahim.
16:48: Did they not see that the shadows of what things Allah has created incline from the right and the left, prostrating to Allah while being humble?
16:49: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of living creatures, and the angels, and they are not arrogant.
16:50: They fear their Rabb from above them, and they do what they are commanded.
16:51: And Allah said: Do not take two deities. He is only One Deity. Fear Me alone.
16:52: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth is His, and religion is constantly His. Is it other than Allah that you guard against?
16:53: Whatever blessing you have is from Allah, then when an adversity touches you, it is only to Him that you cry for help.
16:54: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at that time a group of you associate partners with their Rabb.
16:55: So that they may be ungrateful for what We have given them; thus they will come to know.
16:56: They assign a share of what We have provided them as sustenance to things they do not know. By Allah, they will surely be questioned about the things they used to fabricate.
16:57: They assign daughters to Allah - He is transcendent - and for themselves is what they desire.
16:58: When one of them is given glad tidings of a female, his face darkens and he chokes back his grief.
16:59: He hides himself from the people because of the evil of what he was given glad tidings of. Shall he keep it with humiliation or bury it in the dust? Beware, how evil is the judgment they make!
16:60: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is an evil example, and the highest example belongs to Allah, and He is the All-Mighty, the Possessor of judgment.
16:61: If Allah were to seize people for their wrongdoing, He would not leave any living creature on the earth, but He defers them until a specified term. When their term comes, they cannot remain behind an hour, nor can they precede it.
16:62: They attribute to Allah what they dislike, and their tongues falsely assert that the best is for them.
16:63: By Allah, We certainly sent messengers to nations before you, and Satan made their deeds fair-seeming to them; and he is their protector today, and for them is a painful punishment.
16:64: We sent down the Book to you only so that you may clarify to them that wherein they differed, and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
16:65: Allah sent down water from the sky and brought the earth to life with it after its death. Indeed, in that is a sign for a people who listen.
16:66: Indeed, for you in cattle there is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies, from between dung and blood, pure milk easy to swallow for the drinkers.
16:67: And from the fruits of date palms and grapes you take an intoxicant and a good provision. Indeed, in that is surely a sign for a people who reason.
16:68: And your Rabb revealed to the honeybee: Take dwellings from the mountains, from the trees, and from the trellises they construct.
16:69: Then eat from every kind of fruit and follow the ways of your Rabb submissively. From their bellies emerges a drink of differing colors in which there is healing for people. Indeed, in that is surely a sign for a people who reflect.
16:70: Allah created you, then He causes you to die, and some of you are brought back to the most wretched age of life so that after knowing something, he knows nothing.
16:71: Allah favored some of you over others in provision. Those who are favored do not give back their provision to those whom their right hands possess so that they become equal therein. Is it the blessing of Allah that they deny?
16:72: Allah made for you spouses from your own selves, and from your spouses He made for you sons and grandsons, and He provided you with good things. Do they believe in falsehood and deny the blessing of Allah?
16:73: They worship besides Allah things that possess no provision for them from the heavens and the earth, and have no power.
16:74: So do not set up likenesses to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.
16:75: Allah gave an example: Can an owned slave who has power over nothing and one whom We have provided with a good provision from Us and who spends from it secretly and openly be equal? Praise be to Allah. Rather, most of them do not know.
16:76: Allah gave an example of two men: One of them is mute, has power over nothing, and he is a burden to his master; wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Can this (man) ever be equal to one who enjoins justice and is upon a straight path?
16:77: The unseen of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah, and the matter of the Hour of Resurrection is only like the blink of an eye, or it is even nearer. Indeed, Allah is Powerful over all things.
16:78: Allah brought you out of the wombs of your mothers while you knew nothing. And He made for you hearing, sight, and hearts so that you might give thanks.
16:79: Did they not look at the birds subjected in the open sky? None holds them except Allah. Indeed, in that are signs for a people who believe.
16:80: Allah made for you a place of tranquility from your homes. And He made for you houses from the hides of animals which you find light on the day of your journey and on the day of your stay. And from their wool, their fur, and their hair, He made furnishings and temporary enjoyment until a time.
16:81: Allah made for you shades out of what He created. He made for you shelters from the mountains. He made garments to protect you from the heat and garments to protect you in your battle. Thus He completes His blessing upon you so that you may submit.
16:82: So if they turn away, then upon you is only the clear conveyance.
16:83: They recognize the blessing of Allah, then they deny it, and most of them are disbelievers.
16:84: On that Day We will raise a witness from every nation, then those who disbelieve will not be permitted, nor will they be allowed to make amends.
16:85: When those who do wrong see the punishment, it will not be lightened from them, nor will they be looked upon.
16:86: And when those who associated partners see their partners, they will say: Our Rabb, these are our partners whom we used to invoke besides You. Thereupon they will cast the word at them: Indeed, you are liars.
16:87: And on that Day they cast submission to Allah, and what they used to invent strayed away from them.
16:88: To those who disbelieved and averted from the path of Allah, We increased punishment over punishment because they used to cause corruption.
16:89: On that Day We will raise within every nation a witness over them from their own selves, and We bring you as a witness over these; and We sent down to you the Book explaining all things.
16:90: Indeed, Allah enjoins justice, good conduct, and giving to relatives; and He forbids immorality, evil, and oppression. He admonishes you so that you may take heed.
16:91: Fulfill the covenant of Allah when you make a covenant, and do not break oaths after confirming them, for you have made Allah a guarantor over you.
16:92: Do not be like the woman who untwists and breaks her yarn after spinning it strongly. You take your oaths as a deceit between you, just so that one community may be more numerous than another community. Allah only tests you by it. On the Day of Resurrection, He will surely clarify to you that wherein you used to differ.
16:93: If Allah had willed, He would have made you a single ummah, but He leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills, and you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
16:94: Do not take your oaths as a deception among you, lest a foot slip after its firmness and you taste evil for having hindered from the way of Allah, and for you there is a great punishment.
16:95: Do not sell the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is better for you, if you know.
16:96: Whatever is with you will be exhausted, and whatever is with Allah is enduring. We will surely reward those who are patient with the best of what they used to do.
16:97: Whoever does a righteous deed, whether male or female, while being a believer, We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely pay them their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
16:98: When you recite the Quran, seek refuge in Allah from the outcast Satan.
16:99: Indeed, he has no authority over those who believe and rely upon their Rabb.
16:100: His power is only over those who take him as an ally and those who associate partners with Him.
16:101: And when We substitute a verse in place of another verse—and Allah knows best what He sends down—they said: "You are only a fabricator." Nay, most of them do not know.
16:102: Say: "The Holy Spirit brought it down from your Rabb with truth to strengthen those who believe, and as guidance and glad tidings for the Muslims."
16:103: And indeed We know that they say: "Only a human being teaches him." The tongue of the one to whom they incline is foreign.
16:104: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allah, Allah does not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment.
16:105: Only those who do not believe in the verses of Allah fabricate lies, and it is they who are the liars.
16:106: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief, except the one who is compelled while his heart is at rest with faith, but whoever opens his breast to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment.
16:107: That is because they preferred the life of this world over the Hereafter, and indeed Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.
16:108: Those are the ones whose hearts, ears, and eyes Allah has sealed, and those are the heedless.
16:109: Undoubtedly, they are the very losers in the Hereafter.
16:110: Then indeed your Rabb, for those who emigrated after they were persecuted, then strove and were patient, indeed your Rabb is surely Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
16:111: On that Day every soul will come disputing for itself, and every soul will be paid in full for what it did, and they will not be wronged.
16:112: Allah presented an example of a town that was safe and secure. Its provision was coming to it abundantly from every place. Then it was ungrateful for the favors of Allah, so Allah made it taste the garment of hunger and fear because of what they used to do.
16:113: And indeed a messenger had come to them from among themselves, but they denied him, so the punishment seized them while they were wrongdoers.
16:114: So eat of the lawful and good things that Allah has provided for you, and remember the blessing of Allah if you worship only Him.
16:115: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been slaughtered in the name of other than Allah. But whoever is forced by necessity, without desiring and without transgressing, indeed Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
16:116: Do not say for what your tongues falsely describe, 'This is lawful and this is unlawful,' so as to fabricate lies against Allah. Indeed, those who fabricate lies against Allah will not succeed.
16:117: It is a brief enjoyment, and for them is a painful punishment.
16:118: And to the Jews We forbade what We related to you before. We did not wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves.
16:119: Then indeed your Rabb, for those who do evil out of ignorance, then repent after that and make amends, indeed is Forgiving, Merciful.
16:120: Indeed, Abraham was an obedient leader to Allah, hanif, and he was not of the polytheists.
16:121: He was grateful for His blessings. He chose him and guided him to a straight path.
16:122: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed in the Hereafter he is one of the righteous.
16:123: Then We revealed to you: "Follow the religion of Abraham as a hanif. He was not of the polytheists."
16:124: The Sabbath was made obligatory only upon those who differed concerning it, and indeed your Rabb will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that in which they used to differ.
16:125: Call to the way of your Rabb with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in the best manner; indeed your Rabb knows best who strays from His path, and He knows best those who are guided.
16:126: And if you punish, then punish with the like of that with which you were afflicted, and if you are patient, it is certainly better for the patient.
16:127: And be patient, and your patience is not except with Allah, and do not grieve over them, and do not be in distress because of what they plot.
16:128: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
